gaps.term: direction of inequality for choosing tau
gaps.note: Wrong direction. The page later uses s/W<m^tau (the first unrolled term is O(m^{k tau}) 'because s/W<m^tau'), and the recursion only gives exponent tau when s/W<m^tau. Since s/W<m and m^tau->m as tau->1, one can choose tau<1 with s/W<m^tau. The stated s/W>m^tau contradicts the later use and would not give the O(u^tau) bound.

gaps.term: geometric sum bounded by m^{k tau}
gaps.note: Bounding k (the s/W<=1 case) by O(m^{k tau}) needs tau>0, which the page never states (it only says tau<1), and m>=2 is not given where m is introduced. The hypothesis 0<tau<1 and m>=2 should be stated.
